routeDecision.reason: The requirement still separates reusable implementation, independent observation, and validation responsibilities.

revisedOutcome: Provide a reusable Orca-visible per-session operational projection that identifies the assigned Agent role rather than only the provider, shows the requested objective and current progress, and refreshes a bounded sanitized decision summary at each meaningful transition and after compaction or resume.
reusableBehaviorRequirements: Update on meaningful turn or lifecycle transitions and after context compaction or resume; do not stream raw tokens.
Expose one latest-value surface plus bounded chronological checkpoint history per visible session.
Bind assigned Agent role separately from provider identity.
Carry bounded summary provenance and freshness evidence.
Apply privacy redaction before projection and prohibit private reasoning, prompts, transcripts, credentials, secrets, and runtime handles.
Make update and readback idempotent and preserve recovery after compaction or resume.
Validate current, stale, unknown, unbound, compaction, resume, redaction, and duplicate-update cases.
protectedConstraints: No private chain-of-thought, raw prompt, transcript, secret, credential, or runtime handle may enter the projection.
The observer remains source-read-only and gains no approval, acceptance, integration, publication, or settlement authority.
Provider identity is not a substitute for the assigned Agent role.
A transition refresh is evidence only and cannot imply completion or acceptance.

admissionAssessment.overlapReason: The minimal Workspace Agent Operations Plugin files are already dirty, so a new scoped writer claim cannot be acquired.
admissionAssessment.adjacentConflictReason: The role-aware human communication projection is also pre-existing dirty work without a fresh task-local atomic claim for this successor requirement.

resumeConditions: The exact Plugin and adjacent semantic target paths have settled owners.
A fresh preflight admits the bounded write and an atomic scoped claim is acquired.
The revised reusable-artifact operation request binds the role-aware projection fields and privacy constraints.
An independent validator is assigned after implementation without sharing write ownership.
residualGap: The completed observer validated the original source-hold and memory binding before the durable latest-summary clarification arrived; the clarified reusable behavior has not been independently validated or implemented.
